_README: Single source for the Organization / LocalBusiness JSON-LD node. Every TODO value MUST be copied from the Next.js project source (header/footer logo component, Contact Us page, footer social links, site config). Do not invent values. 'observed_on_live_site' fields are only hints found on https://alvandmarketing.ir on 2026-11-11 to help locate the source; the project source wins if they differ.
name: الوند مارکتینگ

logo.TODO: Absolute URL of the logo used in the project (search public/ and the header/footer Logo component). Prefer a square PNG/SVG >= 112x112.

telephone.TODO: Phone numbers exactly as shown on the Contact Us page (e.g. app/contact/page.tsx or a site config file), in E.164 format.

email.TODO: Email from the Contact Us page.

address.TODO: PostalAddress (streetAddress, addressLocality: تهران, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry: IR) copied from the Contact Us page. If the project has no street address, omit 'address' and the LocalBusiness type, keep Organization only.

geo.TODO: Only if the project already contains coordinates/map embed for the office.

openingHours.TODO: Only if shown in the project (office hours). Support content says 'ساعات اداری'; do not guess exact hours.

sameAs.TODO: Official social profile URLs from the project footer/contact page (Instagram, LinkedIn, Telegram channel, ...). Messaging deep links such as wa.me are contactPoint, not sameAs.

contactPoint.TODO: ContactPoint entries (contactType 'sales' / 'customer support', telephone, availableLanguage ['fa']) from the Contact Us page.

known_live_bug: Live JSON-LD currently uses "@id": "https://alvandmarketing.ir//#organization" (double slash). Use exactly https://alvandmarketing.ir/#organization so it matches the @id referenced by every page's schema_jsonld.
